html:
It has been three days since a word has been heard from the king. On your way to investigate, you and your soldiers were attacked by... something. You were the only survivor. Your only choice is to go to the castle yourself in attempt to find the king. Armed only with your pistol, you must go inside and figure out what happened.

Features:

  • Explore the King's castle, a dark and seemingly abandoned building with many locked doors and items to find. Your map will come in handy.

  • Conserving your resources is vital. Things such as bullets and healing items are in limited supply, so you'll have to explore every corner of the castle, unless you want to meet a dark fate.

  • You might not be alone in the castle, so your gun will be useful. It only shoots one bullet at a time though, and takes a while to reload. So you will have to use your bullets sparingly.

  • Your camera is in a locked 3rd person perspective.

  • The castle's secrets are not for everyone to see. You must find different keys to open the many locked doors that are strewn around the castle grounds.

  • Figure out what happened.
